This technique will summon a large amount of water that will then be used to strike at the opponent in several versatile ways. Shizuku has been known to transform it into a dragon with a gaping mouth to attack. The water used will be stationary till it is sent offensively toward the opponent.

Kimimaro (when in his cursed seal level two form) attacks the enemy repeatedly with alternate strikes from his hands and tail and then finishes off with a powerful strike from his bone drill, knocking the enemy backwards. pl:Nejirihana

The Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist gather as a thick mist surrounds the battlefield. Ameyuri heads in for an attack, delivering an electricity-enhanced horizontal slash with Kiba, followed by Kisame slashing with Samehada in the opposite direction. Jinin launches the opponent up in the air with the axe portion of Kabutowari, where they are met by Jinpachi's attack wih Shibuki, creating an explosion.
